```{r}
library(knitr)
TBL <- here::here("03.outputs", "TBL")
get <- function(n) {
  f <- file.path(TBL, paste0(n, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("missing ", f, ". Render 01.manuscript/Manuscript.qmd first.")
  read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE)
}
cap <- function(n) readLines(file.path(TBL, paste0(n, "-caption.txt")), warn = FALSE)
```

# Table 1

`r cap("table-variables")`

```{r}
kable(get("table-variables"), booktabs = TRUE, align = "lrrrrrrr")
```
